name: Sambar Vada
steps: Soak urad dal 4 hours and toor dal 30 minutes separately. Cook toor dal in 500 ml water until soft; mash. Simmer drumstick, onion and tomato in 400 ml water until tender.
Add mashed dal, tamarind, sambar powder and 8 g salt to the vegetables; simmer 12 minutes. Temper mustard, curry leaves and asafoetida in 25 ml oil and pour into sambar.
Drain urad thoroughly and grind with as little of remaining water as possible into a thick fluffy batter. Beat in ginger, chillies and remaining salt; shape 12 doughnuts with wet hands.
Fry vadas at 175°C for 4–5 minutes until golden and cooked through. Dip briefly in warm water, squeeze gently and soak in hot sambar for 5 minutes before serving.
tips: Beat urad batter until airy and keep water minimal; thin batter makes dense, oily vadas.
passiveTime: 4 hours urad dal soaking and 30 minutes toor dal soaking
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
